# docs.regentra.io — crawler policy (owner directive, 2026-09-08).
#
# Mintlify serves this file verbatim in place of its auto-generated one,
# which allows every crawler and opts the site IN to AI training and AI
# answer generation via Content-Signal. This file reverses that: search
# engines may index the docs so customers can find them; AI crawlers,
# AI-answer fetchers and training-data collectors may not.
#
# robots.txt is honoured voluntarily. Every vendor listed below states
# that it obeys it; a crawler that ignores it can only be stopped at the
# network edge or by putting the docs behind Mintlify authentication.
# Review this list quarterly — new agents appear often.

# Cloudflare Content Signals Policy (https://contentsignals.org):
# search index yes; use as AI input (RAG / AI answers) no; AI training no.
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=no, ai-train=no

# ── OpenAI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Disallow: /

# ── Anthropic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

# ── Google AI (Gemini training / grounding; ordinary Googlebot search is
#    NOT blocked — see the catch-all at the bottom) ──────────────────────
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot
Disallow: /

# ── Perplexity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
Disallow: /

# ── Meta ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
User-agent: Meta-ExternalFetcher
User-agent: FacebookBot
Disallow: /

# ── Apple, Amazon, Microsoft AI, xAI, Mistral, DuckDuckGo AI ───────────
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: Amazonbot
User-agent: MistralAI-User
User-agent: DuckAssistBot
User-agent: xAI-Grok
User-agent: Grok
Disallow: /

# ── Common Crawl and other training-corpus / scraping collectors ───────
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: TikTokSpider
User-agent: Diffbot
User-agent: ImagesiftBot
User-agent: Omgilibot
User-agent: Omgili
User-agent: YouBot
User-agent: cohere-ai
User-agent: cohere-training-data-crawler
User-agent: Timpibot
User-agent: PetalBot
User-agent: AI2Bot
User-agent: Ai2Bot-Dolma
User-agent: Kangaroo Bot
User-agent: Webzio-Extended
User-agent: Scrapy
User-agent: iaskspider/2.0
User-agent: ISSCyberRiskCrawler
User-agent: SemrushBot-OCOB
User-agent: Sidetrade-indexer-bot
User-agent: VelenPublicWebCrawler
User-agent: PanguBot
User-agent: QuillBot
User-agent: Brightbot 1.0
User-agent: Crawlspace
User-agent: Devin
User-agent: Factset_spyderbot
User-agent: FirecrawlAgent
User-agent: img2dataset
User-agent: NovaAct
User-agent: Operator
User-agent: Poseidon Research Crawler
User-agent: bedrockbot
User-agent: meta-externalads
Disallow: /

# ── Everyone else (ordinary search engines: Googlebot, Bingbot, etc.) ──
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /llms.txt
Disallow: /llms-full.txt
